name: proto-go-grpc-no-type-fallback
description: A protoc-gen-go-grpc file and a protoc-gen-connect-go file are rpc-only: each publishes a consumer of the RPC, its client interface method, and no fallback record, because the messages they name are bound by the protoc-gen-go file.
pending: bindings.7: deadset-go publishes no fallback for an rpc-only file, and the RPC consumers of references-go.10 and references-go.11 (GO3b).
